state.background: Review P42-351 unit implementation before deciding whether its matching browser assertion can be removed. tests/components/LazyMount.test.tsx renders the actual LazyMount. It defines a NeverIntersectingObserver that never invokes its callback and has disconnect; stubs getBoundingClientRect beyond innerHeight+200; true flag case asserts immediate child marker and that no observer was instantiated; false control asserts marker absent, observer observed target, and one observer exists. afterEach cleans rendered component, checks instantiated observer disconnect, and restores window flag, global IntersectionObserver, and geometry. Focused verification: `pnpm exec vitest run tests/components/LazyMount.test.tsx` passed 2/2, exit 0. An earlier first matcher run failed because toBeInTheDocument was unavailable; it was replaced by Chai truthy/null assertions and the later run passed. Current exact E2E P42-351 count assertion remains in tests/e2e/mobile-ux.e2e.spec.ts:219. P42-349 initial-unmounted and P42-350 actual scroll/IntersectionObserver E2E checks remain. Plan, ledger, and responsibility matrix all say unit is implemented/verified but removal/migration remains pending this JEV reapproval; they preserve first failure artifact and prior passing plan revalidation. Prior results: results/plan42/p42-351-plan-jev.json has initial implementation_issue (passProbability 0) and unresolved one-time clarification; results/plan42/p42-351-plan-revalidation.json is a plan-only valid_as_defined pass (confidence .71, passProbability .75). OpenSpec R12b requires immediate mount whenever __MOUNT_ALL__ is set before page scripts. In LazyMount source getForceMount is flag true OR missing IO, and checkReach separately mounts when target top <= innerHeight+200; new unit setup neutralizes both alternate conditions and includes false control. No test or E2E execution is requested for this review.

implementation.instructions: Does the implemented P42-351 unit test provide adequate evidence to approve removing only the matching E2E assertion after this review, while retaining P42-349/350 browser checks? Return the complete probability distribution.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The test discriminates the flag branch, verifies true and false behavior, cleans up global state, passes focused verification, and justifies moving only P42-351.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The implementation does not match OpenSpec R12b or a stated acceptance condition; identify the correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A required prerequisite or verification result is absent; identify it exactly.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The code or evidence does not sufficiently establish the behavior; state what exact detail/evidence is needed.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or test issue exists; provide location, evidence, and smallest fix.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposed removal would remove P42-349/350 or other browser behavior; identify the scope correction.
criteria.other: A material concern outside the listed categories; state finding and remedy/evidence needed.
criteria.indeterminate: Evidence is insufficient to judge; identify exact uncertainty.
